source_document.title: PRD QR Manager Settlement Report
source_document.audited_from: pdftotext -layout, read independently of QATOOL's own extractor
source_document.note: Every source_text below is quoted from the PDF. Where the PDF wraps a sentence across lines the quote joins it with single spaces and says so; nothing is paraphrased. Page 6 carries the report format as a raster image rather than text: it was extracted from the PDF image XObjects with pdfjs, upscaled and read directly, and is transcribed here with unreadable portions marked rather than guessed.

classification_rules.ACTIONABLE_BEHAVIOR: A behaviour a tester can set up, perform and confirm from the PRD's own words.
classification_rules.QUALIFIER: A narrowing the PRD attaches to a behaviour. Losing it leaves a test that passes for the wrong reason, so it is counted separately from the behaviour it narrows.
classification_rules.GUARD_CONDITION: A statement of when an action is permitted or forbidden. Distinct from the action: a suite proving the action happens has not tested when it must not.
classification_rules.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: A stated property of an artefact the system produces - a file name, a format, a delimiter, a destination, a value-to-meaning mapping.
classification_rules.NOT_MEASURABLE: Stated, but the PRD gives nothing objective to assert. Never to be satisfied by an invented threshold.
classification_rules.IMPLEMENTATION_INSTRUCTION: Addressed to whoever builds or deploys the system rather than to the system. Its observable consequence, where there is one, is stated elsewhere.
classification_rules.EXAMPLE_SAMPLE: An illustration. Shows the shape of a value; does not make that value required.
classification_rules.BACKGROUND_OBJECTIVE: Context, rationale, or a description of today's behaviour. Not a requirement on the new system.
classification_rules.DOCUMENT_METADATA: Approvals, issue keys, environment addresses, plan. Not system behaviour.

actionable_obligations.requirement: 5. Redefine Timeout Transaction Logic via Check Status
actionable_obligations.source_text: Notes: Retry for Settlement Release is only performed when the status check response is FAILED (transaction not completed) and the retry attempt has not reached 3 times
required_conditions: the status check response is FAILED (transaction not completed)
the retry attempt has not reached 3 times
actionable_obligations.notes: Two conditions, both required. This states when the retry is FORBIDDEN, which a case proving the retry happens cannot prove. The PDF wraps it after 'the status check response is'. Since v1.2.0 the forbidden side is accepted in its own words as well: 'only performed when FAILED and the attempt has not reached 3' is the same rule as 'not performed when the response is not FAILED or the attempt has reached 3'. That form must still negate BOTH conditions in one case - the retry withheld, a non-FAILED response, and the limit reached. A case withholding the retry at the limit alone states half the guard and is still missing; so is one withholding it for a non-FAILED response alone.

not_measurable.requirement: 3. Table Tuning to Fix Report Slowness
not_measurable.source_text: Load and display the transaction data grid quickly
not_measurable.justification: The PRD states a quality and never quantifies it. The only number nearby is '(cost 28 seconds)', which describes today's production behaviour, not a target. No test case may assert a timing threshold here, and inventing one would be a fabricated rule in a SIT script.

implementation_instructions.source_text: Create and implement new automated scheduler to trigger the daily report generation
implementation_instructions.justification: Decided from the structure of this scenario, not from general practice. Under one THEN the PRD lists six bullets; the other five use runtime verbs - Extract, Ensure, Use, Generate, Save - and describe what the software does when it runs. This one uses build verbs, 'Create and implement', and names a component to be constructed. Everything a tester could confirm about it is already stated by the scenario itself: the trigger is the WHEN ('the system clock reaches 03.00 AM', GO-009) and the absence of manual steps is GO-011. There is nothing left for a case to prove that those two do not already prove.

implementation_instructions.requirement: 3. Table Tuning to Fix Report Slowness
implementation_instructions.source_text: Perform Table Tuning to optimize data retrieval process
implementation_instructions.justification: DECIDED from the source, not from practice. The PRD names an activity - 'Perform Table Tuning' - and defines nothing a tester could observe about it: no index, no query, no plan, no target. The only consequence it states is the next bullet, 'Load and display the transaction data grid quickly', which is itself unquantified (GO-041), and the only number on the page is '(cost 28 seconds)', explicitly labelled a current production condition rather than a target. It is IMPLEMENTATION_INSTRUCTION rather than NOT_MEASURABLE because the verb is addressed to whoever builds the system: every sibling bullet in this document's THEN lists describes the running system reacting to a user or a clock, while this one is a maintenance task performed once, off-line, by a DBA.
implementation_instructions.qa_can_observe: Nothing specific. A tester can observe only the grid loading, which is GO-041 and carries no stated threshold. No performance threshold may be invented from the 28 seconds.
implementation_instructions.counter_argument: It is written under 'THEN the system must fulfill:' alongside genuine criteria, and a reviewer could hold it verifiable by database inspection outside SIT. That reading does not change the SIT answer, which is what this oracle measures.

implementation_instructions.source_text: This path IP need to mount to IP Broadridge (by SysAdmin), so transfer data process can works properly
implementation_instructions.justification: Explicitly assigned to SysAdmin and performed outside the application. Infrastructure provisioning, not QR Manager behaviour.

examples.source_text: Below is the Request OFS Message via mscore : { "!OPERATION" : "ENQUIRY.SELECT", "!TRANSACTION_ID" : "E.CHN.VERIFY.FT", "UMG.UNIQUE.ID:EQ" : "{{UMG UNIQUE ID on Release Settlement Requst}}" }
examples.justification: DECIDED on placement, not on how technical the values look. Three things in the source settle it. First, the lead-in: 'Below is the Request OFS Message via mscore :' is the same construction as 'Below is the Response from T24 via mscore :', and that one is unambiguously a specimen - it carries a sample FT number and contradicts itself on RESPONSE.TRX. Second, position: the block sits AFTER the scenario's acceptance criteria and after the Notes, outside the 'THEN the system must fulfill:' list that every requirement in this PRD uses to state obligations. Third, state of completion: the same block holds an unfilled placeholder, '{{UMG UNIQUE ID on Release Settlement Requst}}' (sic), and an unresolved authoring note, '*Tambah Queue name' - a block still being drafted is not a frozen interface contract. ENQUIRY.SELECT and E.CHN.VERIFY.FT are constants rather than specimens, but the PRD nowhere states that the system must send them, and this oracle records what the document requires rather than what the integration probably needs.
examples.if_wrong: If the team confirms these are frozen interface constants, that is a clarification the PRD should carry: the fix is a source change followed by an oracle revision, not a reinterpretation of the current wording.

examples.source_text: Below is the Response from T24 via mscore : { "responseCode": "00", "responseMessage": "Success!", "data": { "RESPONSE.TRX::": "01", "Y.MSG.RES:1:1": "FT26188KDBJZ", ... } }

A specimen FT number inside the mapping table's success row. The rule is that the field carries an FT number (GO-039), never that it equals this one. Asserting this literal would be testing the picture.

background.source_text: The QR Manager application serves as the core platform for managing and executing QRIS settlement activities. Currently, the Settlement Report module faces operational bottlenecks due to heavy data loading, manual extraction workflows, and rigid UI constraints...
Additionally, infrastructure timeouts during settlement releases to the Core Banking system (T24) via Middleware pose significant operational risks...
background.justification: Background paragraph. Names the systems, states no behaviour.

background.source_text: Automate the daily generation and transfer of settlement report files for reconciliation purposes
Implement an isolated queue and automated check-status retry loop to handle timed-out transactions without blocking the main workflow

background.justification: Explicitly labelled 'current condition'. Describes what the system does today; the requirement is Prev 10 / Next 10 (GO-004). A test asserting 100 would be testing the defect.

revision_history.note: First audit. 69 items, 40 actionable. The page 6 report format was recorded as unavailable because the PDF text layer is empty there.

Resolved five pending questions against the source. The largest correction: the report format on page 6 IS readable - it is an image, not missing content - so GO-042 moves from NOT_MEASURABLE to OUTPUT_CONTRACT and the schema it defines becomes new actionable items. GO-021 split into three. GO-038 evidence tightened so coverage and the qualifier metric cannot disagree about one sentence. GO-044 and GO-046 decided; review flags cleared.

Evidence only; no classification changed and the actionable set is still 47. GO-014 now requires the reference point it already listed in required_qualifiers - "from the original timeout timestamp" - so a case asserting any hour-long wait no longer closes it. The same correction GO-038 received in v1.1.0, applied to the one item that still had a qualifier doing no work.

Evidence, plus one optional field; no classification changed and the actionable set is still 47. GO-033 gains alternative_evidence: its own sentence on page 8, 'only performed when the status check response is FAILED ... and the retry attempt has not reached 3 times', is equivalently 'not performed when the response is not FAILED or the attempt has reached 3' - the forbidden side, which this item's note always said a guard is about and which v1.1.1 could not credit. Both negated conditions are required in one case. 'not reached' joins the attempt-count spellings. GO-019 now requires 'again', the page 8 word that separates the re-check from the first Check Status call (GO-015) and the timeout queue (GO-012). The comparator reads alternative_evidence and gained two narrow normalisations, neither of which is a similarity rule: 'times out' / 'timed out' / 'time out' / 'time-out' as 'timeout', and a number term no longer matches inside a longer number.
